title: SnowOps Labs Challenge (challenge.yaml)
description: Schema for a graded SnowOps Labs challenge: set up a broken state, time the fix, grade against checks.

track.description: Area of platform work. Absent means kubernetes.

minutes.description: Expected time in minutes. 0 means not stated.

requires.description: Targets this needs. Absent means [k8s]. List k8s as well as any other target when the cluster is used too.

hintPenalty.description: Percent score deducted per revealed hint (default 5).

ref.description: Name of the scenario or incident to stage (cross-reference checked).

useDetectionCheck.description: Grade using the setup incident's detection check. Requires setup.type == incident.
